title: How the UK High Court held Nirav Modi liable to pay ₹100 crore personal guarantee to Bank of India
description: The High Court of Justice in London has held that fugitive economic offender Nirav Modi is personally liable to Bank of India more than $11 million (over ₹100 crore) under a 2013 personal guarantee in favour of the bank. [Bank of India v. Firestar Diamond FZE & Ors]Deputy High Court Judge Simon Tinkler, sitting at the London Circuit Commercial Court in England and Wales, rejected Modi’s core defences based on Indian foreign exchange law, service of demand and interest calculations.Simon
